Not fully. NASA FIRMS reported **zero thermal detections intersecting the asset** during the covered days from October 13 to November 12, 2026. However, VIIRS S-NPP data were unavailable from November 2 to November 6, so the evidence is insufficient to confirm complete coverage by every sensor for the full period. MODIS, VIIRS NOAA-20 and VIIRS NOAA-21 were covered throughout.

Zero detections also do not prove that no fire occurred.
